meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 不再走 OneCLI 网关,而是从 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 凭证(API 密钥或订阅令牌)注入容器,Claude 用其访问 API。
howto.when: 当你在 .env 里把 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS 设为 true,并提供 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 或 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 之一,重启服务后生效;未设置开关时不生效。

say.text: 改用 .env 里的 Anthropic 凭证,不走 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 会开启原生凭证代理并沿用 .env 配置

say.text: 检查原生凭证代理是否接好,并按 .env 重启服务
say.note: 会运行预检、构建和测试

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw stops using the OneCLI gateway. It reads Anthropic credentials (API key or subscription token) from the .env file and injects them into the container; Claude uses them to reach the API.
howto.when_en: Triggers when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, and the service restarts. Without the flag, the proxy is a no-op.

say_en.text: Switch to Anthropic credentials from .env, bypassing the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Enables the native credential proxy and uses .env settings.

say_en.text: Set NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and start with an API key.
say_en.note: Make sure ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is in .env first.

say_en.text: Check if the native credential proxy is wired, then restart from .env.
